papers.title: De Novo Design and In Silico Validation of a Cationic Antimicrobial Peptide Using an AI-Guided Framework for Membrane Thermodynamics and Hemolytic Toxicity
AMPBAN: A Deep Learning Framework Integrating Protein Sequence and Structural Features for Antimicrobial Peptide Prediction
Generating antimicrobial peptides via genomic transfer learning

models.architecture_or_algorithm: Bilinear Attention Network integrating ESM3 protein language model features, ESMFold-predicted structure features processed by EGNN, and joint sequence-structure features
models.candidate_reason: Novel deep learning AMP predictor using multimodal fusion; outperforms nine state-of-the-art models; code and datasets publicly available.

models.architecture_or_algorithm: Generative Pre-trained Transformer (GPT) with transfer learning from AMPSphere (~863k entries) and fine-tuning on DBAASP; committee of MIC predictive models: Bi-LSTM, ESM-2, QSAR
models.candidate_reason: Transfer learning-based AMP generator with MIC prediction; open-source announced; evaluation planned via AMP Challenge.

important_evidence: AMPBAN model uses ESM3, ESMFold, EGNN and bilinear attention; outperforms 9 state-of-the-art models on multiple benchmarks.
VINCI pipeline uses GPT transfer learning on AMPSphere (~863k entries) and DBAASP, with MIC prediction committee.
BATTLE-AMP benchmark framework available as Snakemake pipeline at https://github.com/szczurek-lab/battleamp-snakemake.
AMPBAN code and data available at https://github.com/baiwenhuim/ampban.
